dependencyContract.summary: Canonical rolling-to-FORGE dependency order for operator surfaces and preflight messaging.
dependencyContract.healthyRunRule: A healthy run requires each blocking stage to complete in order; success in a later stage does not excuse stale or skipped prerequisites.
dependencyContract.validationRule: Do not validate projections, dashboard readers, or downstream materializers until rolling_player_game_metrics, projection ingest, relationship materialization, and projection-derived tables are all fresh for the intended date window.
falseHealthySignals: A successful rolling recompute does not imply projection ingest or derived tables are current.
A successful ingest run does not imply rolling_player_game_metrics or contextual builders are fresh.
A successful downstream accuracy refresh does not imply projection_execution used healthy upstream inputs.

currentStage.label: Projection Execution
currentStage.healthyRunRequirement: Goalie start priors and FORGE projections are only healthy after rolling_player_game_metrics and derived tables are fresh for the same execution window.

prerequisiteStages.label: Rolling Player Recompute
prerequisiteStages.healthyRunRequirement: rolling_player_game_metrics must be recomputed after both skater sources and contextual builders are fresh.

prerequisiteStages.label: Projection Derived Build
prerequisiteStages.healthyRunRequirement: Derived player, team, and goalie strength tables must be rebuilt after ingest, relationship materialization, and contextual refresh.

downstreamStages.label: Projection Accuracy Refresh
downstreamStages.healthyRunRequirement: Accuracy refresh only evaluates projection_execution outputs; it never repairs stale canonical projections.

downstreamStages.label: Monitoring
downstreamStages.healthyRunRequirement: Monitoring is diagnostic only and cannot make an otherwise stale run healthy.

removedShim.note: All surviving projection execution imports should resolve through run-forge-projections.ts.
